# MP3 encoder

lamejs 1.2.1 by Alex Zhukov, a JavaScript port of LAME.
Upstream: https://github.com/zhuker/lamejs
License: LGPL-3.0 (see lamejs-LICENSE.txt and lamejs-COPYING.txt).

lame.min.js is the unmodified browser bundle from the npm release. The full npm source archive is included in lamejs-1.2.1-source.tgz. It can be replaced with a compatible encoder without rebuilding Sample Snip. The extension loads it locally in a dedicated worker; no remote scripts or conversion service are used.
